commands.name: mcp
commands.description: The MCP servers this machine holds, and whether each one is configured.

tools.name: mcp_add
tools.description: Turn one MCP server into one extension package. Starts the server once, reads its tools/list, writes each tool's own JSON Schema into a draft under .nulya/extensions/mcp.<name>/, and builds it into an immutable version. It does not activate anything and puts nothing on a model's tool face: every generated tool is `manual` and not recommended, so a person still names the ones they want. Run it again after the server changes and you get a new version, side by side with the old one. stdio transport only.

name.description: A short name for this server: it becomes the package id (mcp.<name>), the prefix on every generated tool name, and the stem of the file that carries its secrets. Letters, digits, '-' and '_'.

command.description: The command that starts the server on stdio, e.g. 'npx' or an absolute path.

args.description: The command's arguments, one per element.

env.description: The NAMES of the environment variables the server needs (a token, a host). Only the names are frozen into the package; the values are read at call time from .nulya/mcp/<name>.json or <NULYA_HOME or ~/.nulya>/mcp/<name>.json.

tools.name: mcp_list
tools.description: The MCP server packages this machine holds: their versions, the command behind each one, the tools it exposes, and whether the variables it needs have values yet.
